investigation_notes.Description: Multiple Vitalis Healthcare-branded documents were discovered hosted on a Tor hidden service, including a maintenance manual, a product spec sheet, and a 2026 inventory/stock list. The presence of an internal inventory file alongside technical documentation on a dark web archive suggests potential unauthorized disclosure and elevates the risk of targeted reconnaissance or supply-chain exploitation. Because the materials are externally accessible on an onion domain and include inventory data, this alert is considered High Priority and warrants further investigation and escalation.
